summary: SEG-00005 documents the late-stage evolution of Agents.md, showing the consolidation of evaluation definitions directly into Agents.md (eliminating evaluator-definitions.md tracking) and the introduction of commit edda2f29a23c391b584f383e442c764b95064ac2, which formalized live ground-truth verification against deception, added ground_truth_verification_eval, and restructured gate field glossaries.

facts.statement: The specification patch removes external dependency tracking for evaluator-definitions.md (evaluation_documents_read) and designates Agents.md as the canonical evaluation source.

Commit edda2f29a23c391b584f383e442c764b95064ac2 replaces failure examples in Agents.md with a formalized procedure dependency chart and adds live_ground_truth, ground_truth_status (VERIFIED|CONTRADICTED|PARTIAL|UNKNOWN|NOT_EXECUTED), and ground_truth_verification_eval to the contract.

The patch defines explicit execution schemas and supervisory gate schemas for Step 2, Step 3, and Step 4, requiring role verification, granular terminal field evaluation (*_eval), and failures-first reporting order in Step 4.

interpretations.statement: The removal of evaluation_documents_read indicates an intentional architectural supersession: external evaluator definitions are obsolete and merged into the canonical Agents.md.

The live ground-truth verification rule establishes that LLM self-report and ungrounded claims are treated as testimony only, requiring runtime-inspected live evidence before Gemini can issue a PASS gate.

truth_decisions.claim: Requirement for runtime tracking of reading evaluator-definitions.md is superseded.
truth_decisions.rationale: Explicitly eliminated in runtime_integration_requirements within the specification diff.

truth_decisions.claim: Live ground-truth verification and ground_truth_verification_eval are surviving mandatory requirements for the supervisor machine.
truth_decisions.rationale: Introduced in commit edda2f29a23c391b584f383e442c764b95064ac2 to harden gating against fabricated completion and unverified assertions.

requirement_candidates.description: Agents.md must be the canonical evaluation source; no runtime dependency or read-tracking on evaluator-definitions.md may remain.
All materially execution-dependent claims must be independently verified against live ground truth (VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, NOT_EXECUTED) before a PASS gate can be issued.
Step 4 execution returns must report failed actions first, incomplete actions second, and verified completed actions last.

implementation_findings.description: SEG-00005 provides git patch evidence of specification definitions; runtime executable enforcement in send-to-gemini.js or workflow files is referenced in dependency descriptions but not verified in this batch segment alone.

unresolved.description: Executable behavior of collectGroundTruth and groundTruthEvalValid in send-to-gemini.js must be confirmed in code batches to verify whether runtime enforcement matches this late Agents.md specification patch.
